request: Calculate the noise level at the compressor or pump nearest the control room.
headline: Cannot calculate noise - locations and sound ratings missing

gaps.what: noise level at the compressor or pump nearest the control room
gaps.why: P&ID has K-201, P-201, P-101 with no location coordinates and no acoustic ratings; data sheet has process ratings only (flows, areas, pressures) and no sound-power or distance rows; historian has no noise tags; DWSIM spec has no acoustic/propagation physics so the effect cannot be solved, and generic correlations would invent ratings against the rules
gaps.needed: Equipment sound-power levels (dBA per octave or overall for K-201, P-201, P-101), distances/layout coordinates of control room relative to each machine, and an acoustic propagation/building-attenuation model in the spec/tools
